title: Canonical structural coordinates for the coherent unit coefficient
statement: For every scheme X [def-pc-scheme], the lifted tensor-section sheaf of the unit module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module,def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison] is canonically isomorphic to the actual additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction]. Its component at U is the lifted top-section map of tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit U.hom. Pullback of a module multiplication map and coherentEtaleMap have their prescribed section formulas.

proof.text: Use the top-section maps of the adjoint unit-module isomorphisms as the components. The tensor-unit restriction equation proves naturality. Whisker with additive ULift and lift the presheaf isomorphism to sheaves. The component formula is definitional. Applying the tensor-pullback adjunction proves pullback of smulHom; lift the given section formula for the coherent coefficient map.
